description: Compile-only (V1) check for the two subfile lessons: D0611A/F0611A (06-11, JUCLST4 load-all order list with row-select option 5 -> F0604A) and D0611BA/F0611BA (06-11b, SHOHIM add/change/delete maintenance subfile with exclusive-lock discipline). No CALL steps - both are interactive WORKSTN/subfile programs, same non-interactive-SSH limitation as part06-04-10-screens (04-11's established finding). F0611A references F0604A by name (CALL) on option 5 - F0604A itself is compiled by part06-04-10-screens; this manifest does not re-verify that dependency exists, only that D0611A/F0611A/D0611BA/F0611BA themselves compile.
